title: Soul Feast #54: What’s Real? Authentic Power
excerpt: Your emotions are messages from your soul.
bodyHtml:
Your emotions are messages from your soul. Learn How to Tune In and Listen Here.

In this Soul Feast, Gary explores what it truly means to create authentic power. He explains how authentic power emerges from love – gratitude, patience, appreciation, and awe – while external power, rooted in fear, belongs to the old consciousness. Through vivid stories and reflections, Gary reveals how to recognize when fear is active and how to make the quantum leap into love.

Fear and love cannot coexist. When fear controls your choices, you experience pain, judgment, and power struggles. When love guides your actions, you experience harmony, joy, and connection with your soul. Authentic power is not about domination or control – it is about aligning your personality with your soul, moment by moment.

The solution is both simple and challenging: notice when fear is present in your body and mind, then choose to act from love instead. Over time, frightened parts of your personality lose control, and loving parts become your new way of being. This is the practice of authentic power – and it transforms everything.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

  • (00:45) — The new consciousness: why authentic power belongs to the emerging world, and external power to the old one.
  • (03:00) — Love vs. fear: why these two states are mutually exclusive and how they shape your relationships.
  • (06:08) — Emotional awareness: how to recognize frightened parts of your personality through physical sensations and judgmental thoughts.
  • (09:02) — The Michelangelo story: how authentic power is like removing fear to reveal the love already within you.
  • (12:04) — The choice point: how to use free will to shift from fear into love in the moment.
  • (17:48) — Becoming authentically powerful: how patience, gratitude, and awe bring your soul’s energy into the Earth School.
  • (20:55) — The soul notebook: how to experiment with insights and discover what’s worth keeping in your life.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge:

This week, take out your Soul Notebook and reflect on the moments when you noticed fear—judgment, anger, or impatience—and when you chose love—gratitude, patience, or compassion. Ask yourself: What did fear cost me? What did love give me? Write down what you discover, and choose to strengthen the loving parts of your personality by practicing them in real time.
